values.name: Cancellation price
values.description: Price authorized to be charged in the event of an order being cancelled.

values.name: Per ton
values.description: To indicate that the price applies per ton.

values.name: Minimum order price
values.description: A code to identify the price when the minimum number is purchased.

values.name: Export price
values.description: A code to identify the price of a given article for the export market.

values.name: Range dependent price
values.description: A code identifying the price for a specific range of purchase quantities.

values.name: Active ingredient
values.description: The price is referring to the active ingredient.

values.name: As is quantity
values.description: The price is referring to the measured quantity.

values.name: Consumer unit
values.description: The price is referring to the consumer unit.

values.name: ECSC price
values.description: Price registered at European Commission Steel and Carbon office (DG III).

values.name: Traded unit
values.description: The price is referring to the traded unit.

values.name: Theoretical weight
values.description: Weight calculated on ordered dimension (length, width, thickness) not on final dimension (e.g. steel products).
